record.question:
Which of the following parameters accurately defines the structure and tenure of the State Legislative
    Assembly (Vidhan Sabha)?
     1. The maximum strength of an assembly cannot exceed 500, and its minimum strength cannot fall
         below 60, subject to specific constitutional exclusions for smaller states.
     2. During a proclamation of National Emergency, the term of the Legislative Assembly can be
         extended by Parliament by law for one year at a time for any length of time.
     3. The Governor has absolute discretion to dissolve the Legislative Assembly at any time, even
         when the Chief Minister enjoys a stable, verified majority on the floor.
